description: Source code for TeleReporterEmitter class implementing ReporterV2 interface for test reporting, including serialization and event handling logic.

classes.name: TeleReporterEmitter
classes.description: Implements test reporting events and serialization for telemetry emission.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2'.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Serializes configuration and sets root directory.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles beginning of test suite, serializing project info.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Marks test start, assigns GUID, and emits event.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles paused test state, records error count, and emits event.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles test completion, serializes results, and cleans up attachment/error counts.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks step start, assigns GUID, and emits event.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks step end, serializes step data, and attaches attachments.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Emits error event.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles stdout output.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles stderr output.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Internal method to process stdio chunks.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles end of test run, serializes final results.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether reporter prints to stdio (returns false).

methods.name: _serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes full configuration object.

methods.name: _serializeProject
methods.description: Serializes project suite details.

methods.name: _serializeProjectUseOptions
methods.description: Serializes project 'use' options.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _serializeTest
methods.description: Serializes individual test case details.

methods.name: _serializeResultStart
methods.description: Serializes test result start info.

methods.name: _serializeResultEnd
methods.description: Serializes test result end info, including errors and annotations.

methods.name: _sendNewAttachments
methods.description: Sends new attachments for a test result.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes attachments, optionally base64 encoding.

methods.name: _serializeStepStart
methods.description: Serializes step start info.

methods.name: _serializeStepEnd
methods.description: Serializes step end info, including attachments and errors.

methods.name: _relativeAnnotationLocations
methods.description: Converts annotation locations to relative paths.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts absolute location to relative path.

methods.name: _relativePath
methods.description: Converts absolute file path to relative path based on rootDir.
